evidence.detail: PerfectRun and FlawlessRun achievements already exist for 5-0 league runs; SQL uses dc.wins >= 5 AND dc.losses = 0 from deck_cache
preaggregate_omw() stores omw as a 0–1 fraction in deck_cache; dc.omw > 0.5 would express '>50% opponent match win percentage'

triage.notes: The implementation is straightforward (a new CountedAchievement subclass ~20 lines), but the achievement name, display description, exact threshold (>50 vs >=50), and whether it should stack with PerfectRun or replace it for those runs all require an owner decision.
